dg-marshall-premium-ferret-diet.title: Marshall Premium Ferret Diet (22 oz)
dg-marshall-premium-ferret-diet.summary: A complete dry food for ferrets of all ages. Ferrets are obligate carnivores, so this recipe leads with chicken and is made to be easy to digest, with balanced amino acids and fats.
rows: Chicken by-products (organs only), chicken, chicken by-product meal, corn meal
